method: Allowlisted AST literal/constant/spread interpretation; no eval, import or execution of target source.

task_summary.description: Privacy-safe declared task goals. Supply categories only; NEVER include names, paths, document text, chat titles or user prompt text. This records AI understanding, not user authorization.

task_mode.description: Infer from user intent: only redact -> redact_only; AI processing without requested restoration -> ai_process; process and restore -> ai_process_restore. Star masks and overlays cannot be restored.

source_path.description: Opaque local file OR folder path supplied by the user. A folder must be forwarded unchanged in one tool call; never enumerate it or start one task per contained file.

source_paths.description: All explicitly supplied input files in one batch call. Never split this array into multiple redaction tasks.

profile.description: Exact saved Lawbot profile name or ID; unknown profiles fail instead of silently falling back.

pseudonymRules.description: Type-level custom token prefixes or selective pseudonym/mask actions. No original text. Masked categories cannot be restored. Use custom_pseudonym or selective_pseudonym exportMode respectively.

unified_pseudonyms.description: Batch default is true so all outputs and derived reports share one restorable project mapping. Pass false only when the user explicitly requests independent mappings.

batch_result_mode.description: Use combined only when the user requests one merged result. It requires unified pseudonyms; the software assembles approved sanitized MD only. Receive the parent artifact once rather than process each child separately.

sanitized_output_dir.description: Optional ONLY when the user explicitly requested this output folder. Otherwise OMIT; Lawbot uses its software settings. Never choose an AI workspace folder yourself. Requires the user to approve the override in the initial local authorization.

restored_output_dir.description: Optional ONLY when the user explicitly requested this output folder. Otherwise OMIT; Lawbot uses its software settings. Never choose an AI workspace folder yourself. Requires the user to approve the override in the initial local authorization.

file_settings.description: Only when the user requests different settings for specific input files. Forward each source_path opaquely; all unspecified settings inherit batch defaults. Never include original text. Unified custom prefixes must be consistent across files.

profile.description: Exact saved Lawbot profile name or ID; unknown profiles fail instead of silently falling back.
